symbols.name: real part
symbols.meaning: The real part of a Gaussian integer, which is an integer.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian integer is a complex number $a+bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both integers.

symbols.name: imaginary part
symbols.meaning: The imaginary part of a Gaussian integer, which is an integer.
symbols.quote: A Gaussian integer is a complex number $a+bi$ whose real part $a$ and imaginary part $b$ are both integers.

symbols.name: imaginary unit
symbols.quote: Here $i$ is the imaginary unit, the number with $i^2=-1$.

symbols.name: Gaussian integers
symbols.meaning: The set of all Gaussian integers.
symbols.quote: Write $\mathbb{Z}[i]$ for the set of all Gaussian integers.
